TEST 18 — THE GATE: does a forward Δt signal exist in this data?
population-level (t_i -> t_j) pairs, leave-one-donor-out ridge.
If this fails, the stopping-time tool is not supported by this dataset.

  DATA AVAILABLE
┌──────┬────────────┬───────┬───────────────┐
│ fold │ timepoints │ cells │ forward pairs │
├──────┼────────────┼───────┼───────────────┤

│ O1   │         12 │    21 │            66 │
│ O2   │         12 │    20 │            66 │
│ Y1   │         11 │    18 │            55 │
│ Y2   │         12 │    21 │            66 │
└──────┴────────────┴───────┴───────────────┘
   total forward pairs across donors: 319

  CELLS PER TIMEPOINT — the load-bearing assumption of the whole design
┌──────┬────────────┬───────┬──────────┬───────────────────┬──────────────────────┐
│ fold │ timepoints │ cells │ cells/tp │ SE at one tp (yr) │ vs 11.35 effect      │
├──────┼────────────┼───────┼──────────┼───────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
│ N3   │         12 │    20 │      1.7 │         13.2-16.3 │ ** EXCEEDS EFFECT ** │
│ O1   │         12 │    21 │      1.8 │         12.9-15.9 │ ** EXCEEDS EFFECT ** │
│ O2   │         12 │    20 │      1.7 │         13.2-16.3 │ ** EXCEEDS EFFECT ** │
│ Y1   │         11 │    18 │      1.6 │         13.3-16.4 │ ** EXCEEDS EFFECT ** │
│ Y2   │         12 │    21 │      1.8 │         12.9-15.9 │ ** EXCEEDS EFFECT ** │
└──────┴────────────┴───────┴──────────┴───────────────────┴──────────────────────┘
   !! WARNING: at some donors the per-timepoint uncertainty EXCEEDS the effect
      size. The condition-level argument (±3.7-4.6 yr) assumed all cells at one
      timepoint; they are spread across the course. Mitigations, in order:
        (a) POOL adjacent timepoints into wider bins (trades time resolution
            for statistical resolution) -- usually the right call
        (b) report only COARSE recommendations (early / mid / late)
        (c) if neither is acceptable, the tool cannot resolve withdrawal days

│ Y1       │    55 │      22.84 │     311.47 │ -288.64 │

└──────────┴───────┴────────────┴────────────┴─────────┘
   aggregate: state=20.67  state+Δt=86.77
   paired (state+Δt − state): mean=+66.11 95% CI=[-89.10,+221.31] (n=5)  -> tied (no Δt signal)

  PART B — sweep Δt from 0.20 to 10.49 (log-h), START STATE HELD FIXED

│ fold │ ΔAge @ short Δt │ ΔAge @ long Δt │   swing │

  PART C — forward UNSAFE-FRACTION MAE (lower better)  ***THE DECISIVE ONE***
  the recommendation is gated by p_unsafe, not ΔAge — this is what it runs on.
┌──────────┬───────┬────────────┬────────────┬────────┐
│ held-out │ pairs │ state only │ state + Δt │   gain │
├──────────┼───────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────┤
│ N3       │    66 │      0.437 │      0.997 │ -0.560 │
│ O1       │    66 │      0.411 │      0.362 │ +0.049 │
│ O2       │    66 │      0.408 │      0.592 │ -0.184 │
│ Y1       │    55 │      0.424 │      7.589 │ -7.165 │
│ Y2       │    66 │      0.362 │      0.509 │ -0.147 │
└──────────┴───────┴────────────┴────────────┴────────┘
   aggregate: state=0.409  state+Δt=2.010
   paired: mean=+1.601 95% CI=[-2.270,+5.472] (n=5) -> tied (NO forward safety signal)

   VERDICT:
     => STOP (or REDESIGN). Δt cannot predict the UNSAFE FRACTION forward.
        The recommendation is gated by p_unsafe, and ΔAge intervals overlap too
        heavily to separate adjacent days on their own. Without forward safety
        prediction the recommender has nothing to recommend with -- even if
        Parts A/B look fine. Options: (a) ship a ΔAge-trajectory readout with NO
        safety recommendation, (b) get data with more unsafe-cell variation.

   CAVEAT: pairs share timepoints so they are not independent — a screen, not a
   proof. A NEGATIVE result is decisive; a POSITIVE one is permission to proceed.
